full_name: Paulo Fontes | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 History Rita E. Hauser Fellow Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro (Brazil)
bio: A historian of Brazilian labor and working-class culture after World War II, Paulo Fontes is a professor at the Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro and the author of several articles and books on these topics.
